evidence.evidence_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered significant attention due to their remarkable ability to process information across various languages.
This paper introduces a method to enhance the multilingual performance of LLMs by aggregating knowledge from diverse languages.
This approach incorporates a low-resource knowledge detector specific to a language, a strategic language selection process, and mechanisms for answer replacement and integration.
